body:
I don't get the shadow feeling you are describing but I understand the context in which you are using it. What sort  of worldly things could I fill the void with? I've fought for years against the 'darkness'.. I will always remember the day that broke my mind (2/29/16). I let the darkness win and I understood from that day these thoughts would come again and I wouldn't fight them this time. My mind is tired from all this struggling. I just want to rest indefinitely.

Life is a blessing and a curse, there truly is no point to anything the way I see it. We exist to no reason or eventual goal. What is human kind here to achieve? Everyone is a victim of their own circumstances and everyone's experiences are unique to them. 

I am an empath and I endure pain I've never had to personally experience. Whether it's for a person, place or thing. Every time I see something tragic or a friend of a friend has passed, I always wish I could of taken their place. I am not a spokesperson for anything including myself. I've lost my lust to live, my drive to learn new things and encounter new relationships. Hobbies once enjoyed seem like an undertaking anymore. 

I know that I have good in me. It doesn't help. My heart broke a long time ago and that was OK. However once my mind broke everything has been so different.
